local function albumOf(p408: string) -- Line: 1863
    -- upvalues: CardData (copy)
    local Song = CardData.getSong(p408);

    if not Song then
        return nil, nil;
    end;

    local Artist = CardData.getArtist(Song.artistId);

    if not Artist then
        return nil, nil;
    end;

    for _, v in Artist.albums do
        if v.id == Song.albumId then
            return v, Song;
        end;
    end;

    return nil, nil;
end;
